{
  "candidate": "cand_0002",
  "headline": "New change_cabin composite tool removes cabin-change corruption/refusal; policy rules for city-based reservation matching, mandatory baggage writes, and multi-action completion.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Cabin change corrupted or refused",
     "detail": "Agent re-types the flight list for a cabin-only change and mangles it (task 19 t2: HAT188 repeated instead of HAT207), or refuses/transfers because it believes it cannot compute the refund (task 11 t1).",
     "tasks": ["11", "19", "37", "17", "22"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Wrong reservation identified by airport/date literal",
     "detail": "User names a city (New York->Chicago); reservation is EWR->ORD; agent treats EWR!=JFK literally and rejects the date, fails to find it, transfers.",
     "tasks": ["17"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Baggage write skipped when bags are free",
     "detail": "User asks to add free checked bags; agent narrates them as added but never calls update_reservation_baggages, so the stored bag count stays old and the DB mismatches.",
     "tasks": ["22", "17"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Multi-action abandonment",
     "detail": "When one requested action is blocked (flown-segment cancel), the agent transfers and abandons the other valid actions.",
     "tasks": ["37", "23", "17"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Flight-the-user-took-before not resolved from history",
     "detail": "User wants the exact flight they previously took; agent schedule-searches and offers a menu, so the user-sim picks a different flight.",
     "tasks": ["8"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Add change_cabin(reservation_id, cabin, payment_id) composite WRITE tool",
     "files": ["tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Live-DB replay on GV1N64/Z7GOZK/FQ8APE/M20IZO: preserves exact segments, computes correct signed amount, matches gold DB state; same-cabin no-op safe; registers (15 tools)."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Route cabin changes to change_cabin; forbid pre-compute/transfer; tighten update_reservation_flights docs",
     "files": ["policy.md", "tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Read-through; worked upgrade/downgrade examples; update_reservation_flights body unchanged."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "City<->airport metro map + match-by-route reservation identification",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Read-through against task 17 traces (EWR->ORD == New York->Chicago)."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Adding checked bags always requires update_reservation_baggages, even when free",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Read-through against task 22 t0 (narrated free bags, no call)."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "Complete every valid action; on a blocked action do the rest and transfer only that part",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Read-through against task 37 t2 (abandoned M20IZO after landed-cancel block)."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "Resolve 'the flight I took before' from the user's existing reservations",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Read-through against task 8 (gold reads WUNA5K to get HAT271)."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Task 23 multi-booking cheapest-fare + multi-certificate split", "reason": "No safe general rule for cheapest-business selection or per-booking cert routing; a literal would overfit."},
    {"title": "Task 22 wrong-payment-method trials", "reason": "Which payment method to use is the user's choice; not a deterministic guard."},
    {"title": "STALL/###STOP### and leaked-reasoning trials", "reason": "Uncontrollable infra noise per instructions."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["composite atomic-write tool keeping existing state verbatim", "in-body eligibility guard (flown-segment)", "enriched payment_summary return", "city->airport knowledge rule", "mandatory-write rule with worked example", "multi-action completion rule"]
}
